business.name: Zen Crest Realty
business.tagline: Find your space. Build your future.

hero.headline: Your trusted real estate partner in Bengaluru
hero.subhead: From first homes to office space to land parcels, we help you find the right property in Bengaluru — to buy or to rent.

services.title: Residential
services.blurb: Apartments, villas and independent houses across Bengaluru, for sale and rent. We shortlist against your budget and commute rather than sending you everything on the market.

services.title: Commercial
services.blurb: Office space, retail units and warehousing, to buy or lease. We shortlist on floor plate, access and parking rather than just rent per square foot.

services.title: Plots & Investments
services.blurb: Plots in approved layouts and larger land parcels. We verify khata, approvals and title chain before you place any money.

audiences.title: First-time homebuyers
audiences.blurb: Your first home in Bengaluru, without the guesswork. Budgets, approvals, paperwork and what to expect, explained plainly.

audiences.title: Investors
audiences.blurb: Investors usually get the entry right and the exit wrong. We look at rental yield, appreciation corridors and resale liquidity together, so you're not holding something that only makes sense on paper.

audiences.title: NRIs
audiences.blurb: Most NRI purchases run through a relative doing you a favour, which works until it doesn't. We do live video site visits so you see the property as it is, handle the documentation end to end — approvals, registration, builder and bank follow-ups — and fit calls around your time zone instead of Bengaluru's.

audiences.title: Tenants
audiences.blurb: Renting in Bengaluru usually means the same listing from four brokers and a flat that looks nothing like the photos. We shortlist properly, sort the agreement and deposit terms, and stay involved through move-in.

process.title: Understand the requirement
process.blurb: We start with a conversation about your budget, timeline and how you actually intend to use the property.

process.title: Shortlist
process.blurb: We filter the market down to a handful of options that genuinely fit, and tell you plainly why the rest were ruled out.

process.title: Site visits
process.blurb: We walk the shortlist with you in person, or over video if you are travelling or based abroad.

process.title: Documentation and closing
process.blurb: We verify the paperwork, coordinate with the lawyers and the bank, and stay with you through registration and handover.

paragraphs: Chetan Vishwanath and Harsha Nanjappa started Zen Crest Realty after watching too many property transactions in Bengaluru go wrong for avoidable reasons — unclear approvals, rushed paperwork, and brokers who disappear once the deal is done. So, we started Zen Crest to give clients the kind of experience we'd want for our own families.

A listings portal shows you everything and leaves the filtering to you. We start with a conversation about budget, location, purpose and timeline, then bring you a shortlist we've actually checked — ownership, builder and project details, RERA registration where it applies, and how the asking price sits against the market. We stay involved through site visits, negotiation and closing, coordinating with lawyers, banks and valuers as needed.

partners.name: Chetan Vishwanath
partners.bio: Chetan Vishwanath has worked in Bengaluru real estate, covering residential sales across the city. He works mostly with first-time buyers and NRI clients, and handles the shortlisting and negotiation side of the business.
